lines: In Siddha-doctrine Kuṇḍalinī-śakti breath-equal-transcendent said; and in Yoginī-Kaula that this by Supreme Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: siddhāmate kuṇḍalinīśaktiḥ prāṇasamonmanā uktaṃ ca yoginīkaule tadetatparameśinā
